title: Febe Cplanes And Coordinate Input
summary: The existing per-view CPlane and typed local/world input did not satisfy all seven L3 oracles. Implemented named Top/Front/Right presets, validated origin/rotation/three-point frames, W and @ relative text entry, F4 world-origin insertion, and Ortho/Planar cursor constraints; added 22 focused tests across core, scene and app.

gaps_found: No CPlanePreset/Top/Front/Right contract; workspace carried ad-hoc axes.
No origin/rotation/three-point frame constructor or typed rejection of collinear points.
Typed input accepted local coordinates only; W and @ prefixes were not parsed.
F4 toggled the world datum instead of inserting the world origin in a point prompt.
No Ortho/Planar cursor constraint state or viewport wiring.
No cross-view test proving the stored point remains world-space.

code_changes: crates/om9-core/src/coords.rs: CoordinateInput::Relative, parse_input for W/@, resolve_with_base, frame delta_to_world
crates/om9-scene/src/camera.rs: CPlanePreset, CPlane::preset, with_origin, rotated, from_three_points
crates/om9-scene/src/workspace.rs: the four default views use the preset constructors
crates/om9-app/src/session.rs: last_point, ortho/planar state, constrain_point, submit_world_origin, set_cplane_preset/from_three_points/origin_rotation, revision-bumped set_cplane, W/@ submission
crates/om9-app/src/ui.rs: F4 origin insertion during a point prompt; constrained hover/click point
crates/om9-app/src/viewport_menu.rs + src/session.rs: Set CPlane Top/Front/Right actions
